page.layout: One page of verse, one column set in the centre; no margin notes; a catchword-like signature "Ipsi" at the lower right corner.

main_text.p: At tu magne puer Diuûm genus, vnica Terris Expectata quies, longo defessus ab aeuo Regnandum tibi cum GENITOR concesserit orbem, Excipe puberibus quae prima sacramus ab annis Munera devotae monumenta, & pignora mentis; Tempus erit cum facta PATRIS miranda nouantem Carmine te maiore canam, quandoque feroces Contuderis Turcas, & Regum colla minantur Ad sacra templa trahes curru sublimis auito, Innumerosque mari referes ab utroque triumphos; Nunc Tibi militiae curas dum mollior aetas Inuidet auspicijs maiorum inuenta tuorum Regna lege & pugnanda animo iam concipe bella.

Soluerat Hispano iam dudum littore classis Solis in occasum, pelagi tentare latentes Missa sinus, positasque alio sub sydere terras; Intactas penitus terras, quas omnis iniquo Damnatas aestu nequicquam credidit aetas Desertosque vacare locos, & inhospita Regna Iamque supra Hesperidas variis iactata periclis Errabat pelago in magno, tamen omnia contra Ventorumque minas, sauique incommoda coeli Pergit iter fatis Dux tanta ad munera lectus Cristophorus, coeptisque ardens ingentibus instat Aspirant faciles aurae, miratque monstrum Non prius incuruae rostro sulcata carinae Subsidunt vltro, & motus freta coerula ponunt,

page.notes: Verse set in italic with long s as plain s; the printed line "Ipsi" at lower right is a catchword-like word. Some words in the first line are printed in mixed type (GENITOR, PATRIS in capitals). Several readings are uncertain due to scan quality, e.g. "Inuidet", "Pergit", "Cristophorus", "Subsidunt" may be imperfect.
